hunks.baseline: The team snapped into formation. I gripped my spear and moved as ordered. Between the tank and the ranged dealers. Dead center—that was my spot.
hunks.sol: The team snapped into formation. I gripped my spear and moved as ordered. Between the tanks and the ranged dealers. Dead center—that was my spot.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong planted his tower shield in the ground and shouted,
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong planted his tower shield in the ground and shouted.

hunks.baseline: Mana-charged arrows flew in a straight line. They had enough force to punch through most shields, but…
hunks.sol: Mana-charged arrows shot straight at the Great Warrior. They had enough force to punch through most shields, but…

hunks.baseline: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior flicked its greatsword and chopped every one of them in half. Even if they’d hit, I doubted they could have pierced that hide.
hunks.sol: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior gave its greatsword a casual swing and chopped every one of them in half. Even if they’d hit, I doubted they could have pierced that thick hide.

hunks.baseline: With a booming roar, the green giant launched into the air.
hunks.sol: With a booming roar, the green giant leaped into the air.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong screamed,
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong screamed.

hunks.baseline: Before anyone had time to think, they threw themselves aside.
hunks.sol: Before anyone had time to think, we threw ourselves aside.

hunks.baseline: Everything was a wash of haze. Nobody could tell friend from foe. This was my opening.
hunks.sol: Everything was lost in the haze. Nobody could tell friend from foe. This was my opening.

hunks.baseline: I stayed low and moved slowly. Spear in one hand, the other feeling through empty air.
hunks.sol: I stayed low and moved slowly, spear in one hand while the other felt through empty air.

hunks.baseline: I’d thought I was farther out, but I must have been closer than I expected.
hunks.sol: I’d thought I was farther away, but I must have been closer than I expected.

hunks.baseline: I looked back down. Between thighs as thick as pillars and hard as stone, my dainty little hand was clamped around something.
hunks.sol: I looked back down. Between thighs as thick as pillars and hard as stone, my dainty little hand was gripping something.

hunks.baseline: That was a male’s instinct. Unbearable nausea. Disgust at myself. The next moment, my grip went slack on its own.
hunks.sol: It was male instinct. Unbearable nausea. Disgust at myself. The next moment, my fingers loosened of their own accord.

hunks.baseline: My hand dropped, limp—and the greatsword rose with force.
hunks.sol: My limp hand slid down as the greatsword rose with force.

hunks.baseline: That one was actually close. I ducked at the last second; the greatsword skimmed over my head and wrecked the cave wall.
hunks.sol: That one was actually close. I ducked at the last second, and the greatsword skimmed over my head and wrecked the cave wall.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t enough to pull the Great Warrior’s attention. Its eyes had already rolled back.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t enough to pull the Great Warrior’s attention away from me. It was already seeing red.

hunks.baseline: The greatsword barely missed. Crisis after crisis, and I still hadn’t let the C-rank Rare Monster land a single clean hit.
hunks.sol: The greatsword barely missed. It had been one close call after another, yet I still hadn’t let the C-rank Rare Monster land a single clean hit.

hunks.baseline: It sounded insane, but it was true. I could see the attacks. Moving half a beat ahead was what was keeping me alive.
hunks.sol: It sounded insane, but it was true. I could see its attacks. Moving half a beat ahead was what kept me alive.

hunks.baseline: I cut toward the voice. The team was waiting there in a defensive formation again.
hunks.sol: I turned toward the voice. The team was waiting there in a defensive formation again.

hunks.baseline: With a short shout, Im Kkeokjeong brushed past me. And then—
hunks.sol: With a short shout, Im Kkeokjeong rushed past me. And then—

hunks.baseline: Something broke, and he shot backward at a vicious speed.
hunks.sol: Something broke, and he shot backward at terrifying speed.

hunks.baseline: That was the sound of the team wiping. The last member had charged in with a dagger, taken a knuckle to the skull, and gone flying. He twitched, then passed out.
hunks.sol: That was the sound of the team being wiped out. The last member had charged in with a dagger, taken a knuckle to the skull, and gone flying. He twitched, then passed out.

hunks.baseline: A brutal fight was still going on at the altar in the distance.
hunks.sol: A fierce battle was still raging at the altar in the distance.

hunks.baseline: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior came on slowly. A cruel smile hung on its wide-slit mouth. I eased back in time with its steps.
hunks.sol: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior came toward me slowly. A cruel smile hung on its wide-split mouth. I eased back in time with its steps.

hunks.baseline: My heart dropped as I watched its back heading for Im Kkeokjeong.
hunks.sol: My heart dropped as I watched it head for Im Kkeokjeong.

hunks.baseline: All I got was being ignored completely.
hunks.sol: It ignored me completely.

hunks.baseline: I had to pull its eyes somehow. I grabbed a rock off the ground and threw it at the monster’s head.
hunks.sol: I had to get its attention somehow. I grabbed one of the rocks scattered around me and threw it at the monster’s head.

hunks.baseline: A one-on-one against a C-rank Rare Monster.
hunks.sol: A one-on-one fight against a C-rank Rare Monster.

hunks.baseline: I was already charging at it. Sometimes you have to fight even when there’s no chance.
hunks.sol: I was already charging at it. Sometimes you had to fight even when you had no chance.

hunks.baseline: The green giant turned like it had been waiting. A smug smile sat on its mouth. The greatsword swept in horizontally, a streak of light shooting for my side.
hunks.sol: The green giant turned like it had been waiting for me. A smug smile curled its lips. The greatsword swept horizontally, shooting toward my side like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: My mind went white. Could I even block that? Had I made the wrong call out of some cheap guilt and heroics?
hunks.sol: My mind went white. Could I even block that? Had I made the wrong call out of some pathetic sense of guilt and heroism?

hunks.baseline: There are times you fight with your life on the line. This was one of them.
hunks.sol: There are times you have to fight with your life on the line. This was one of them.

hunks.baseline: I clenched my teeth and turned the iron spear into its path. At the same time, the greatsword smashed into it.
hunks.sol: I clenched my teeth and wrenched the iron spear around to intercept it. At the same time, the greatsword smashed into the shaft.

hunks.baseline: A roar of impact. Then enormous pressure. The greatsword, iron spear and all, split straight through my waist—
hunks.sol: A roar of impact. Then enormous pressure. The greatsword cleaved straight through the iron spear and my waist—

hunks.baseline: The iron spear was fine. So was my waist. All that had happened was my feet had been pushed back a little. A very, very little.
hunks.sol: The iron spear was fine. So was my waist. All that had happened was my feet had been pushed back a little.
A very, very little.

hunks.baseline: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s face flushed bright red. It pulled the greatsword back and smashed it down on the iron spear again. Even through the confusion, I tightened my grip and blocked.
hunks.sol: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s face flushed bright red. It pulled the greatsword back and hammered the iron spear again. Even through the confusion, I tightened my grip and blocked.

hunks.baseline: “…Uhh.”
hunks.sol: “…Huh.”

hunks.baseline: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s eyes met mine in the air between us. I’d been through this somewhere before.
hunks.sol: The Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s gaze met mine. I’d been through this somewhere before.

hunks.baseline: I froze. For that instant, I couldn’t see or hear a thing.
hunks.sol: I froze. For that instant, I couldn’t see or hear anything else.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
>
> Synchronization complete.
>
> All systems are inherited.
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> Synchronization complete.
>
> All System functions have been transferred.

hunks.baseline: A wrinkled hand clutched at a throat. But the old goblin had neither the strength to stop the blood pouring out like a waterfall nor the time to spit out the spell still sitting on the tip of its tongue.
hunks.sol: A wrinkled hand clutched at a throat. But the old goblin had neither the strength to stop the blood pouring out like a waterfall nor the time to utter the spell still sitting on the tip of its tongue.

hunks.baseline: But he turned around at once. He still had work to do. A C-rank Rare Monster was going to be a brutal fight, so—
hunks.sol: But he turned around at once. He still had work to do. Who knew how brutal a fight it would take to bring down another C-rank Rare Monster—

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi thought he was seeing things. That same Hobgoblin Great Warrior was screaming. One arm gone, it was staggering back.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi thought he was seeing things. That same Hobgoblin Great Warrior was screaming. With one arm severed, it staggered backward.

hunks.baseline: He watched the fight, even forgetting he was supposed to help. Ghostlike movement. A spear-point pouring like water, carving the green giant to pieces.
hunks.sol: He watched the fight, forgetting that he was supposed to help. Ghostlike movement. A spearhead flowing like water as it carved the green giant to pieces.
